system.description: When you select this archetype at 1st level, you tap into the pod person hive mind, causing you to feel acute loneliness combined with a strong sense of belonging. When you would normally make a check to recall common knowledge about pod people or snatcher-pod plants, at the Narrator’s discretion you automatically have the desired knowledge. You also gain an expertise die to recall knowledge about other plants or any creature with the plant type, and your expertise die can increase to a d10 for this knowledge.
